outputs.name: UX07-served-browser-evidence

reject: fewer than two or more than three schemes can be presented as a comparison
a scheme lacks its saved record id, document version, saved timestamp, or complete canonical document hash
a saved signature that differs from the reopened document hash is accepted, hidden, or silently repaired
two records with the same canonical document hash are presented as different schemes
program, area, cost, constraint, readiness, provenance, or export facts are retyped or recomputed outside their existing owning modules
an option is called best, recommended, optimal, compliant, approved, or ready without a declared objective and evidence
selecting, ordering, clearing, or viewing a comparison changes project state, editor history, geometry, persistence, or the active design hash
a corrupt, unreadable, future, deleted, or concurrently changed library record becomes a partial or stale comparison column
opening a compared scheme bypasses the existing explicit library open and undo path
a public-site, 3D, renderer, animation, engine, scene, model, texture, shader, camera, lighting, motion, or quality-tier path changes
verification: fixture: stale, duplicate, corrupt, future, deleted, and more-than-three candidate sets fail closed
fixture: legacy and planar-graph schemes derive identity, program, area, cost, blocker, and export facts only from existing owners
browser evidence: two and three saved schemes can be selected, ordered, compared, and cleared by keyboard
browser evidence: changing the reference column changes only factual deltas and never labels a winner
browser evidence: selection, comparison, reference changes, and clearing leave the active design hash and undo history unchanged
browser evidence: opening a scheme remains an explicit existing library action and one undo restores the prior project
